subject: Dedicated compute island qualification, SLA targets & next steps
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sabrina Cole <sabrina.cole@helixthera.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated compute island qualification, SLA targets & next steps

Hi Sabrina —

Great to meet today — thanks for walking us through HelixThera's inference profile and the near-term product milestones. Below is a concise recap (TL;DR), the risks we heard, and the proposed next steps so we can keep moving toward a committed Reserved Pool.

TL;DR
- Target: reserved pool for production inference (initially 4x A100-equivalent GPUs; expected to expand to 8 within 6 months).
- Isolation: full-tenant isolation preferred (no shared multi-tenant hosts), must support PHI handling for models that touch patient PII.
- Performance SLOs: p95 latency target <= 200ms for 512-token chats; sustained throughput target ~6K tokens/sec across the pool during peak windows.
- SLA ask: 99.9% availability with mission-critical priority for failover and on-call routing.

Key pain points you shared
- Latency spikes during batch inference and KV-cache cold-warm cycles.
- Procurement timeline complexity (security & legal gating the commit).
- Need for clear fallbacks: quantized-model variant and cross-region fallback if capacity constrained.

Draft decisions we recommend (so we can align ops and procurement)
1) Isolation model: dedicated tenant nodes with network segmentation + KMS integration. Owner: Aditya.
2) Canary plan: 2-week canary on a 1-GPU reserved slice, then promote to 4x pool. Canary target: early August. Owner: Monica.
3) SLA baseline: 99.9% monthly uptime (SLA draft attached). We can discuss credits tiers during contract. Owner: Laura / Legal.
4) Ops readiness: we will provide a workload-profile template — please confirm sample traces (attached: helix_traffic_profile.csv).

Action items & owners
- HelixThera: confirm procurement lead and SOC 2 point-of-contact (Sabrina) — due: 2025-07-16.
- Redwood: send SOC 2 attestation + security contact (Irene) and the Reserved Pool SLA draft (attached) — due: 2025-07-14.
- Both: schedule 30-min procurement/ops sync (target week of 7/21). Proposed times: Tue/Wed AM PT.

Open/Questions for you
- Do you have specific blackout windows for deployments (regulatory maintenance windows)?
- Any regional requirements beyond US (we heard potential EU rollout in Q4)?

Attachments: helix_traffic_profile.csv, redwood_dedicated_sla_draft_v1.pdf

If that all looks right I can (1) circulate a short Mutual Action Plan with dates and owners, and (2) loop in Irene (security) to start the SOC 2 exchange.

Thanks again — I’ll wait for procurement contact info and a preferred slot for the ops sync.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Dedicated compute island qualification, SLA targets & next steps

Appreciate the fast turnaround, Sabrina — looping in the people who will drive the technical and security pieces from our side. Quick responses inline: 

- Ops checklist for canary: Aditya — see the short checklist below (we’ll also push a one-page runbook).
  * Validate model cold-start and KV-cache warm-up (measure p95 over first 1k requests).
  * Traffic replay using attached profile (run 3 independent 2-hour windows).
  * Monitor host-level telemetry (GPU utilization, NVLink, memory pressure) and token-level latency.
  * Canary acceptance: p95 <= 200ms and sustained throughput >= 60% of committed target for 12 of 14 days.

- Trial pricing and commercial owner: Monica will lead commercial for a 60-day canary trial and follow up with a proposed commercial term sheet (cc’d).

Next concrete steps (Mutual Action Plan draft)
- 2025-07-14: Redwood sends SOC 2 summary + SLA draft (Irene & Laura) — ACTION: Irene/Laura.
- 2025-07-16: HelixThera confirms procurement and security POCs (Sabrina) — ACTION: Sabrina.
- 2025-07-21 to 07-25: Ops/procurement sync (schedule to be agreed; Monica to propose slots) — ACTION: Monica/Sabrina.
- 2025-08-04: Canary start window (proposed) — ACTION: Aditya/Helix ops.

Irene, attaching a short security intake request: can you prepare SOC 2 summary + list of evidence we’ll need? (send to Amit directly and copy Sabrina/Procurement).

Thanks everyone — Monica will send proposed slots for the week of 7/21 by EOD Monday.

Laura

Karen — nice to meet you over email. Per our call with Sabrina and Amit, we prepared the short Mutual Action Plan and the canary checklist. Monica will follow up with proposed calendar slots; in the meantime please review the attached SLA draft.

Quick note on SLA language you may care about: we call out an availability SLA (99.9% monthly), prioritized incident response for reserved pools (1-hour acknowledgement, 4-hour mitigation target for Sev1), and credits tied to monthly uptime thresholds. We are open to negotiating the credit schedule in procurement.

Expected immediate asks from Procurement
- Confirm purchase order cadence and initial term (12 months typical; we can discuss 6-month pilot terms).
- Review the SLA and provide any redlines you want to start with (we can accept redlines via DocuSign or HubSpot).
- Provide final SOC 2 contact for direct evidence exchange — we’ll share our attestation and a security intake checklist (Irene cc’d).

Monica will send the calendar options shortly. If a phone is faster, I'm available 9–11am PT most days this week.

Thanks — looking forward to moving to canary.
